overrides.answer: You should strain all of your urine through the strainer provided and save any stone pieces in the container for your follow-up visit. Additionally, check your temperature every evening for 7 days. If you cannot urinate, call the clinic. Make sure to drink enough fluids to make at least 2.5 liters of urine a day, which usually means about 3 liters (12 cups) of fluid daily, mostly water. If you notice any heavy bleeding or clots, call the clinic [23, 24, 35, 37, 46, 50].
